visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long black hair wearing a white sweater sits at a white counter in a bright indoor setting, smiling and holding a smartphone with a floral case toward the camera. A second woman with short black hair leans in from the side, squinting and tilting her head to see the screen, which appears dark from her angle. (2) The scene shifts to a different indoor setting with black paneling; the short-haired woman, now wearing a black apron over her white sweater, holds a tablet and looks at the long-haired woman. The long-haired woman presents her phone for scanning, but the short-haired woman struggles to see it, tilting the phone back and forth with a confused facial expression. (3) Both women stand together in a living room area with a sofa and plush toys in the background; they prepare for a selfie, the long-haired woman holding the phone up high. As they pose, the short-haired woman looks at the screen and her face turns into a grimace of frustration because she cannot see the preview. (4) The short-haired woman is now on the floor, crawling toward a smartphone lying on the tiles; she uses her fingers to aggressively pick at the edge of the screen protector while shouting. The long-haired woman leans over her, appearing concerned as they both struggle over the device on the floor.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-pitched, upbeat electronic BGM with a strong, repetitive rhythmic pulse. A female voice speaks in a friendly, inviting tone, followed immediately by a sharp 'ding' sound effect. (2) After a hard cut, the same BGM continues. A second female voice asks a question with clear, professional articulation. A metallic 'click' or 'ding' sounds when the first voice responds briefly. (3) A third phase features both female voices interacting playfully over the steady beat; the volume of the speech is moderate. A sudden, slightly distorted 'What?' vocal meme SFX triggers a transition. (4) The final phase features loud, high-arousal shouting from the second female voice, accompanied by the sound of scuffing and clothes rustling against a floor. The BGM maintains its tempo, but the vocal intensity peaks before a clean stop.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To humorously illustrate the common frustrations and social 'inconveniences' caused by high-privacy smartphone screen protectors through a series of relatable daily scenarios.
